source_title: Vermont DMV — Rules Governing Overweight & Overdimension Vehicle Permits (CVO-110)
verify_reasons: Live sourcing attempted + blocked: the official Vermont DMV CVO-110 rules PDF and the dmv.vermont.gov/CVO/permits/rules page both returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch this run. Escort thresholds (escort at width over 12', length over 80', overhang 15'+, height over 13'6" restricted) and the $48 single-trip starting fee are cross-referenced from third-party summaries of CVO-110 — confirm with VT DMV CVO (802-828-2064) before dispatch.

Vermont sets no fixed statutory/administrative dimension or weight that automatically requires a Vermont State Police escort; VSP escort is imposed at the Commissioner of Motor Vehicles' discretion — police triggers left false with note.

Vermont publishes no fixed numeric superload threshold; loads over ~150,000 lbs gross undergo engineering review (per secondary summaries) — superload_thresholds left null (handler raises a verify flag, does not auto-assert superload).
Single-trip permit validity (days) and the overweight fee schedule above the $48 base are unconfirmed — quote through VT DMV.

superload_thresholds.note: Vermont publishes no fixed superload dimension/weight threshold. Loads over roughly 150,000 lbs gross undergo engineering review (per secondary summaries of CVO-110); any escort/VSP requirement is set at the Commissioner's discretion. Null values flag the load for manual superload verification rather than clearing it.

width.note: 1 escort at width 12'0" or greater (CVO-110); Commissioner may require additional escorts / VSP at discretion

height.note: height over 13'6" is restricted / route-reviewed; escort per Commissioner (CVO-110)

length.note: 1 escort at overall length over 80', or with rear overhang of 15' or greater (CVO-110)

single_trip.fee_formula: Single-trip oversize permit starts at $48; overweight fees scale with gross weight — exact overweight schedule not confirmed from official CVO-110 this run (quote through VT DMV CVO).
single_trip.note: Escort must be at least a compact car; escorts maintain two-way radio contact and display 'OVERSIZE LOAD' signage.

annual.note: Annual/blanket overdimension permits available for qualifying repetitive moves; fee via VT DMV CVO.

movement_restrictions: Travel one-half hour before sunrise to one-half hour after sunset, 7 days a week
Weekend travel prohibited for loads exceeding 100' long, 10'6" wide, or 108,000 lbs gross
Escort vehicles must maintain two-way radio contact with the permitted vehicle at all times and carry a 360-degree amber warning light
notes: Legal limits: width 8'6", height 13'6", gross 80,000 lbs; 53' semitrailer on the National Network.

Governing rule: Vermont DMV CVO-110 'Rules and Instructions Governing Overweight and Overdimension Vehicle Permits' — official page/PDF 403-blocked this run; values cross-referenced from third-party CVO-110 summaries.
